source.text: Burger mit Fries und Käse Sauce bestellt - einfach komplett Fries und Sauce vergessen. Top, war auch ne komplizierte Bestellung.
source.textTranslated: Ordered a burger with fries and cheese sauce – they completely forgot the fries and sauce. Great, and it was a complicated order.

claims.text: ordered a burger with fries and cheese sauce
they completely forgot the cheese sauce

reference.notes: The closing 'Top, war auch ne komplizierte Bestellung' is sarcasm, so it is read as negative about order accuracy; it may be kept apart or folded into the forgotten-items claim. The forgotten Fries and Sauce are a complaint, so opinion, with fact also allowed.
